Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the personal use of state-provided electronic devices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the personal use of stateprovided electronicdevices; and amending RCW 42.52.160.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.52.160 and 1996 c 213 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No state officer or state employee may employ or use anyperson, money, or property under the officer's or employee's officialcontrol or direction, or in his or her official custody, for theprivate benefit or gain of the officer, employee, or another. (2) This section does not prohibit the use of public resources tobenefit others as part of a state officer's or state employee'sofficial duties. (3) This section does not prohibit the use of stateprovidedelectronic devices for personal use, so long as the personal use doesnot diminish the product's value or interfere with any state employee'sperformance of public duties. (4) In addition to the provisions of subsection (3) of thissection, the appropriate ethics boards may adopt rules providing p. 1 SB 5040exceptions to this section for occasional use of the state officer orstate employee, of de minimis cost and value, if the activity does notresult in interference with the proper performance of public duties.
